messages:
maria: sketch for stacktrace panel iteration — focusing on scrolling, frame pagination, and the export copy. dropping screenshots and a quick flow. want input on keyboard nav + export wording.
ashok: thanks! quick glance — the collapsed frame behavior looks good, but how does pagination interact with KV cache traces? can we keep correlation id pinned while paging?
sam: +1 on pinning correlation id. if you page, we should keep the header with request id visible. makes copy/paste easier for support.
maria: agreed. current mock pins a small bar with request id + copy button. thinking about making the id always present on narrow widths (sticky top). thoughts on ARIA for the copy button?
dana: aria-label="Copy request id" is fine. but also expose a role=region with aria-labelledby so SR users can jump to the request metadata. suggest: <region aria-labelledby="req-meta">Request metadata</region>.
ashok: also need keyboard support for frame pagination: left/right arrow or tab+page buttons? keyboard users expect page buttons to be tabbable and have aria-current for active page.
oliver: would prefer prev/next buttons plus page number input. screen readers can announce "page 2 of 4" if we add aria-live when switching.
maria: good call. UX question: label for the export action. current copy says "Export stack" — feels vague. other options: "Download stacktrace", "Export trace (.json)", "Copy stack" (for quick copy).
sam: lean to "Download trace (JSON)" when it's a file download, and "Copy stack" for a clipboard copy action. keep them as two separate affordances.
dana: accessibility nit — make sure both buttons have distinct aria-labels and tooltips, e.g., "Download trace as JSON" and "Copy stack trace to clipboard". tooltips should be reachable via keyboard focus.
maria: mock has a single kebab menu with both actions. is that discoverable?
oliver: kebab is fine for advanced actions, but a primary inline "Copy" button is nice for support flow. most folks want quick copy. put primary copy left, kebab for download + permalink + open in new tab.
ashok: another point: stack frame wrapping. current design truncates long file paths with ellipses. for keyboard users we should provide an expansion toggle per frame — aria-expanded, and maybe an inline monospaced pre when expanded.
dana: yes, use <button aria-expanded> to toggle full frame. also ensure focus order doesn't skip the expanded content.
maria: copy tweak for correlation id display: in header we currently show "Correlation ID: <id>". someone suggested label should be just the id and a small caption "Correlation ID" to reduce scan noise. opinions?
sam: caption-only reduces clutter. visually show the id in a monospace pill and a small "Correlation ID" label above. keeps the id front-and-center for copy.
ooliver: minor visual: the pill should wrap on narrow screens, allow break-all for long UUIDs? or better keep as single line with horizontal scroll inside the pill and a visible copy icon.
dana: horizontal scroll inside pill can be awkward for SR. prefer a button that reads the full id or opens a dialog showing metadata. aria-live then announces "Correlation ID copied" on copy.
maria: noted. analytics question: do we have events for "export clicked" vs "copy clicked"? product wants separate metrics.
ashok: we do — send events trace.export.download and trace.export.copy. also add attribute for user_tier and model so we can correlate.
sam: accessibility QA — keyboard sequence: focus enters panel -> header -> primary copy -> kebab -> frame list -> pagination -> footer actions. can we add a visible focus ring that is high-contrast? current mock has a faint ring.
olm: +1 on stronger focus ring. use 3px solid brand contrast color or 2px with offset. also test with high-contrast mode.
dana: screen reader text: when you open a frame details, announce first line of stack frame and file path. maybe use aria-live polite for that.
maria: I'll iterate the mock: make copy primary, kebab for download/permalink, sticky request id with copy button, toggle per-frame expand with aria-expanded, page controls with aria-current and aria-live. stronger focus ring and explicit aria-labels/tooltips. any other copy tweaks?
sam: change the export menu label from "Export" to "Share & export" — indicates both actions live there (permalink + download).
ashok: small perf note: if users page through many frames, lazy-load frame expansions to avoid long DOM.
maria: good call. i'll add that to the handoff doc.
uxbot: checklist added: [x] aria-labels for copy/download [x] pagination aria-current [x] sticky request id [ ] keyboard focus ring adjustments [ ] analytics events documented
maria: thanks everyone! will post revised frames and a short video of keyboard flow later today :eyes:
